summary: Packs a 3D float vector (a2) into three signed 16-bit components written at this+0x9, this+0xB and this+0xD. Each component is scaled by 64.0 after passing through FloatToRGBColorConversion and ShortVectorToFloatWithScale, and is clamped: values within +/-511.98001 become the scaled integer, otherwise they saturate to -32767 or 0x7FFF. The vector then feeds ShortComputation_29f0/FloatThresholdClassification for a classification pass and BitfieldExtractScale/BitfieldUpdateFromFloat for a bitfield update whose result is returned. Invoked by EntityVisibilityGridManager (00465460).

local_names.this: receiver holding the three packed int16 outputs
local_names.a2: input 3D float vector, also treated as a short vector by the rescale and extract helpers

operations.description: Stage the input vector into three locals: v14 = a2[0], v15 = a2[1], v16 = a2[2]
FloatToRGBColorConversion converts the staged float triple into a packed color-like value stored into the receiver
ShortVectorToFloatWithScale rescales the short-vector interpretation of a2 back through the staging floats
X component clamp-and-scale: if within +/-511.98001 multiply by 64.0 and truncate to int16, otherwise clamp to -32767 or 0x7FFF; write the word result to this+0x9
Y component clamp-and-scale: same +/-511.98001 / 64.0 / -32767 / 0x7FFF handling; write the word result to this+0xB
Z component clamp-and-scale: same +/-511.98001 / 64.0 / -32767 / 0x7FFF handling; write the word result to this+0xD
ShortComputation_29f0 derives a classification input v12 from the input vector a2
FloatThresholdClassification classifies the receiver using the computed v12 value
BitfieldExtractScale derives a scale/bitfield value v13 from a2
BitfieldUpdateFromFloat applies v13 to the receiver's bitfield and its return value is returned to the caller; the function is invoked by EntityVisibilityGridManager (00465460)
